about: Synthetic lab report texts for the model eval (RV-MM1 AC8). Each text is copied verbatim from the parser fixture named in copiedFrom; each expected row lists the name, result, unit and printed interval exactly as that text prints them (phases: a cycle-phase interval list, not scored as one range). Nothing here is a clinical range.
